title: JOURNAL_STYLE_CONTEXT_V1
description: Style adaptation context for one journal, consumed by scholarly-voice-engine. Deliberately keeps official requirements and observed corpus patterns in separate fields -- this distinction is mandatory (see rule 34 / shared/terminology.md) because the two carry different evidentiary weight.

journal_identifiers.description: Identity metadata (ISSN, publisher) -- not a style requirement, not observed evidence. Populated by journal-fit-engine's own index evidence lookup (see jfe.style_context.journal_identifiers_from_evidence).

official_requirements.description: Stated in the journal's author guidelines: word limits, citation style, structure mandates, blinding rules.

observed_patterns.description: Style regularities observed by scholarly-corpus-builder across a sampled corpus of published articles. Descriptive, not mandatory.

evidence.description: Provenance entries for official_requirements/observed_patterns (see provenance.schema.json's PROVENANCE_RECORD_V1 -- this is a plain list of sources, not a second provenance schema).

limitations.description: Evidence gaps and honesty flags (e.g. 'no official_requirements supplied', 'stale freshness') that must be preserved by every downstream consumer, never silently dropped.
